units.source_text: 内大臣后房姬妾众多，所生男儿不少，都已按照其生母的出身及本人的品质，随心所欲地予以地位和权势，使之各得其所了。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior had many ladies and concubines in his household, and no few sons had been born to him; according to each mother's rank and each son's own qualities, he had freely bestowed position and power on them, so that each had found his proper place.

units.source_text: 但所生女儿不多，加之长女弘徽殿女御企图皇后之位，终未成功，次女云居雁希望入宫，亦事与愿违，内大臣引为憾事。

en.t: But he had not had many daughters, and moreover his eldest daughter, the Kokiden Consort, had sought the position of empress and failed, while his second daughter, Kumoi no Kari, had hoped to enter the palace but things had not gone as wished; the Minister regarded this as a matter of regret.

units.source_text: 因此昔年夕颜所生的女儿，他始终不忘，每逢机会，总提到这个孩子。

en.t: For that reason, he never forgot the daughter whom Yugao had borne long ago, and whenever an opportunity arose, he would always mention the child.

units.source_text: 他想：“这个人不知怎么样了。

en.t: He thought, "I wonder what has become of that person.

units.source_text: 很可爱的一个女儿，跟了那个水性杨花的母亲，弄得下落不明。

en.t: She was such a lovely daughter, yet she went with that fickle mother and ended up disappearing without a trace.

units.source_text: 可见对于女子，无论如何，切不可以放松监视。

en.t: This shows that, with girls, one must never relax one's watch over them, whatever happens.

units.source_text: 我生怕此人不知轻重，向人说出是我的女儿，而度着下贱的生涯。

en.t: I am terribly afraid that she, not knowing what is proper, may tell people she is my daughter while living in a lowly way.

units.source_text: 不管怎样，但愿她来找我才好。”

en.t: Whatever the case, I only wish she would come and seek me out."

units.source_text: 他一直挂念在心。

en.t: He kept thinking of her all the time.

units.source_text: 又对诸公子说：“你等倘听到有自称是我女儿的人，必须留意。

en.t: He also said to his sons, "If any of you hear of someone claiming to be my daughter, you must pay attention.

units.source_text: 我年轻时，任情而动，做下了许多不应有之事。

en.t: When I was young, I acted as my feelings led me and did many things I should not have done.

units.source_text: 但其中有一女子，与众不同，非庸碌之人。

en.t: But among them there was one woman who was different from the rest, no ordinary person.

units.source_text: 只因一念之差，与我离异，不知去向。

en.t: Only because of one mistaken impulse, she parted from me, and I do not know where she went.

units.source_text: 我家女儿本已甚少，连她所生的一个也失去了，实甚可惜。”

en.t: There were already very few daughters in my family, and to have lost even the one she bore is truly a great pity."

units.source_text: 他常常说这话。

en.t: He often said such things.

units.source_text: 当然有时也不去想它，完全忘记了。

en.t: Of course, there were times when he did not think of it and forgot it completely.

units.source_text: 但每逢看见别人为女儿多方操心之时，便想起自己不能如意称心，不胜悲伤懊恼。

en.t: But whenever he saw others taking great pains over their daughters, he remembered that his own wishes had not been fulfilled, and he was overcome with sorrow and vexation.

units.source_text: 有一次他做了一个梦，宣召最高明的详梦人来详，那人言道：“恐有一位少爷或小姐，多年遗忘，已为他人之螟蛉，不久将有消息。”

en.t: Once he had a dream and summoned the most skilled dream interpreter to explain it; the man said, "It seems there is a young lord or lady who has been forgotten for many years and has become another person's adopted child; before long there will be news."

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“女子而为他人之螟蛉，向来无有。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said, "There has never been such a thing as a girl becoming another person's adopted child.

units.source_text: 不知究竟如何。”

en.t: I wonder what this really means."

units.source_text: 此时他又想起玉鬘其人，时时提及。

en.t: At this point he again thought of Tamakazura, and he mentioned her from time to time.
